MORE:
The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. November 05, 2026, which commenced at 04.30 p.m. and concluded at 05.30 p.m. have discussed, considered and approved the following:
The unaudited Standalone and consolidated financial results of the Company along-with Limited Review Report issued by Statutory Auditor of the Company, M/s Rakchamps & Co. LLP for the Quarter and Half-Year ended September 30, 2026. A copy of the aforementioned financial results and the Limited Review Reports issued by the Statutory Auditors are enclosed.
The Board has approved that the book keeping address of the Company be changed and books of account and other relevant papers shall now be maintained at the Registered Office of the Company situated at 3501, Floor -35, Vertu Tower, Katrak Road, Wadala Market, Wadala, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, 400031.
